svg.aria-label: Front end as simulated: a 6-tap shunt ladder from I+ to I minus; each tap switch with its UCC27524 driver referenced to I+ and 22 ohm gate resistor; group H behind the isolation FET Qi, whose gate is tied to the follower U7 by Qb while off; group M straight on I minus; and the stage-1 amplifiers on sense taps 3, 5 and 6 (OPA210, OPA210, OPA387).
svg.text: STAGE2 → stage 2, stage 3, AAF, ADC (chain figure)
Isolation-gate boot: every driver 0 / +5 V from I+; while Qi is off, Qb ties its gate to the follower, which also holds ihi through Rtih
